javanese: Sang Begawan gadhah brengos panjang ngantos nutupi lesanipun.
english: The Begawan had a long mustache that covered his mouth.

indonesian: Sang Begawan mempunyai kumis panjang hingga menutupi mulutnya.
javanese: Sang Begawan kagungan rawis panjang ngantos nutupi tutukipun.
english: The Begawan had a long mustache that covered his mouth.

indonesian: Mandilah, handuk dan sabun sudah disiapkan di kamar mandi!
javanese: Adusa, andhuk karo sabun wis dicawisake ing kamar mandhi!
english: Take a shower, the towel and soap have been prepared in the bathroom!

indonesian: Mandilah, handuk dan sabun sudah disiapkan di kamar mandi!
javanese: Panjenengan siram, andhuk karo sabun wis dicaosake ing kamar mandhi!
english: Take a shower, the towel and soap have been prepared in the bathroom!

indonesian: Mandilah, handuk dan sabun sudah disiapkan di kamar mandi!
javanese: Sampeyan adus, andhuk kaliyan sabun sampun dipuncawisaken ing kamar mandhi!
english: Take a shower, the towel and soap have been prepared in the bathroom!

indonesian: Mandilah, handuk dan sabun sudah disiapkan di kamar mandi!
javanese: Panjenengan siram, andhuk kaliyan sabun sampun dipuncaosaken ing kamar mandhi!
english: Take a shower, the towel and soap have been prepared in the bathroom!

indonesian: Pak Guru itu rajin dan jujur, maka dianggap dekat (dikasihi) oleh Kepala Sekolah.
javanese: Pak Guru kae sregep lan temen, mula kacedhak dening Kepala Sekolah.
english: The teacher is diligent and honest, so he is considered close (loved) by the principal.

indonesian: Pak Guru itu rajin dan jujur, maka dianggap dekat (dikasihi) oleh Kepala Sekolah.
javanese: Pak Guru menika sregep lan temen, mila kacelak dening Kepala Sekolah.
english: The teacher is diligent and honest, so he is considered close (loved) by the principal.

indonesian: Jika melihat kera jangan dekat-dekat, jangan sampai digigit!
javanese: Manawa ndeleng munyuk aja cedhak-cedhak, mundhak dicakot!
english: If you see a monkey, don't get too close, don't let it bite you!

indonesian: Jika melihat kera jangan dekat-dekat, jangan sampai digigit!
javanese: Manawi ningali munyuk sampun celak-celak, mindhak dipuncakot!
english: If you see a monkey, don't get too close, don't let it bite you!

indonesian: Dari sini hingga Purwareja itu dekat-dekatnya lima puluh kilometer.
javanese: Saka kene tekan Purwareja iku cedhak-cedhake seket kilometer.
english: From here to Purwareja, it's approximately fifty kilometers.

indonesian: Dari sini hingga Purwareja itu dekat-dekatnya lima puluh kilometer.
javanese: Saking ngriki dumugi Purwareja menika celak-celakipun seket kilometer.
english: From here to Purwareja, it's approximately fifty kilometers.

indonesian: Benderanya dipegang dahulu, akan saya kibarkan!
javanese: Genderane dicekel dhisik, arep dak kerek!
english: Hold the flag first, I will wave it!

indonesian: Benderanya dipegang dahulu, akan saya kibarkan!
javanese: Genderane diasta dhisik, arep adalem kerek!
english: Hold the flag first, I will wave it!

indonesian: Benderanya dipegang dahulu, akan saya kibarkan!
javanese: Genderanipun dipuncepeng rumiyin, badhe kula kerek!
english: Hold the flag first, I will wave it!

indonesian: Benderanya dipegang dahulu, akan saya kibarkan!
javanese: Genderanipun dipunasta rumiyin, badhe adalem kerek!
english: Hold the flag first, I will wave it!

indonesian: Ayam sedang baik-baiknya dipegang itu jika dilepas hilang.
javanese: Pitik cumekel mangkono iku yen diculake ilang.
english: The chicken is being held well, if released it will be lost.

indonesian: Ayam sedang baik-baiknya dipegang itu jika dilepas hilang.
javanese: Ayam cumepeng makaten menika yen dipunculaken ical.
english: The chicken is being held well, if released it will be lost.

indonesian: Pak Purba memegang cambuk kecil, agaknya akan naik kuda.
javanese: Pak Purba nyekel cemethi,sajake arep nunggang jaran.
english: Mr. Purba is holding a small whip, seemingly about to ride a horse.

indonesian: Pak Purba memegang cambuk kecil, agaknya akan naik kuda.
javanese: Pak Purba ngasta tembung, sajake arep nitih titihan.
english: Mr. Purba is holding a small whip, seemingly about to ride a horse.

indonesian: Pak Purba memegang cambuk kecil, agaknya akan naik kuda.
javanese: Pak Purba nyepeng cemethi, sajakipun badhe numpak kapal.
english: Mr. Purba is holding a small whip, seemingly about to ride a horse.

indonesian: Pak Purba memegang cambuk kecil, agaknya akan naik kuda.
javanese: Pak Purba ngasta tembung, sajakipun badhe nitih titihan.
english: Mr. Purba is holding a small whip, seemingly about to ride a horse.

indonesian: Wah, wajahnya seperti suami (istri)-mu waktu masih kecil.
javanese: Wah, raine kaya cilikane bojone biyen.
english: Wow, their face looks like your husband (wife) when they were little.

indonesian: Wah, wajahnya seperti suami (istri)-mu waktu masih kecil.
javanese: Wah, pasuryane kaya timure ingkang garwa biyen.
english: Wow, their face looks like your husband (wife) when they were little.

indonesian: Wah, wajahnya seperti suami (istri)-mu waktu masih kecil.
javanese: Wah, rainipun kados alitanipun semah sampeyan rumiyin.
english: Wow, their face looks like your husband (wife) when they were little.

indonesian: Wah, wajahnya seperti suami (istri)-mu waktu masih kecil.
javanese: Wah, pasuryanipun kados timuripun ingkang garwa rumiyin.
english: Wow, their face looks like your husband (wife) when they were little.

indonesian: Surat ini dicukupkan sekian dahulu, lain waktu dilanjutkan.
javanese: Layang iki kacukup samene dhisik, liya wektu dibanjurake.
english: This letter is concluded for now, it will be continued another time.

indonesian: Surat ini dicukupkan sekian dahulu, lain waktu dilanjutkan.
javanese: Surat menika kacekap samanten rumiyin, sanes wekdal dipun lajengaken.
english: This letter is concluded for now, it will be continued another time.

indonesian: Sesudah bertransmigrasi, dia menjadi orang kaya (serba cukup).
javanese: Sawise transmigrasi, dheweke dadi wong kecukupan.
english: After transmigrating, he became a wealthy person (having everything he needs).

indonesian: Sesudah bertransmigrasi, dia menjadi orang kaya (serba cukup).
javanese: Sasampunipun transmigrasi, piyambakipun dados tiyang kecekapan.
english: After transmigrating, he became a wealthy person (having everything he needs).

indonesian: Nasi dengan lauk ini dicukup-cukupkan supaya terpakai (dimakan) sehari!
javanese: Sega karo lawuh iki dicukup-cukupake supaya kanggo sadina!
english: The rice with these side dishes is rationed so that it lasts (is eaten) for a day!

indonesian: Nasi dengan lauk ini dicukup-cukupkan supaya terpakai (dimakan) sehari!
javanese: Sekul kaliyan lawuh menika dipuncekap-cekapaken supados kangge sadinten!
english: The rice with these side dishes is rationed so that it lasts (is eaten) for a day!

indonesian: Sudah menjadi kebiasaan orang desa, mereka hidup saling mencukupi.
javanese: Wis dadi kalumrahane wong desa, enggone urip padha cukup-cinukupan.
english: It has become a habit for the villagers; they live by supporting each other.

indonesian: Sudah menjadi kebiasaan orang desa, mereka hidup saling mencukupi.
javanese: Sampun dados kalimrahanipun tiyang dhusun, enggenipun gesang sami cekap-cinekapan.
english: It has become a habit for the villagers; they live by supporting each other.

indonesian: Selama suami saya pergi, bantulah mencukup-cukupkan kebutuhan rumahtangga!
javanese: Sajrone bojoku lunga, rewangana nyukup-nyukupake kabutuhan ngomah!
english: While my husband is away, please help make ends meet for the household!

indonesian: Selama suami saya pergi, bantulah mencukup-cukupkan kebutuhan rumahtangga!
javanese: Sadangunipun semah kula kesah, sampeyan rencangi nyekap-nyekapaken kabetahan nggriya!
english: While my husband is away, please help make ends meet for the household!

indonesian: Jika hanya membutuhkan cabai saja membawalah secukup-cukupnya!
javanese: Yen mung butuh lombok wae nggawaa sacukup-cukupe!
english: If you only need chili peppers, just take as much as you need!

indonesian: Jika hanya membutuhkan cabai saja membawalah secukup-cukupnya!
javanese: Yen namung betah lombok kemawon sampeyan mbekta sacekap-cekapipun!
english: If you only need chili peppers, just take as much as you need!

indonesian: Yang menari sanggulnya memakai cunduk bunga melati.
javanese: Sing njoged gelungane mawa cundhuk kembang mlathi.
english: The dancer's bun is adorned with jasmine flower hairpins.

indonesian: Yang menari sanggulnya memakai cunduk bunga melati.
javanese: Sing beksa ukele mawa sangsangan kembang mlathi.
english: The dancer's bun is adorned with jasmine flower hairpins.

indonesian: Yang menari sanggulnya memakai cunduk bunga melati.
javanese: Ingkang njoged gelunganipun mawi cundhuk sekar mlathi.
english: The dancer's bun is adorned with jasmine flower hairpins.

indonesian: Yang menari sanggulnya memakai cunduk bunga melati.
javanese: Ingkang beksa ukelipun mawi sangsangan sekar mlathi.
english: The dancer's bun is adorned with jasmine flower hairpins.

indonesian: Sesuai dengan undangan, rapatnya dimulai pukul delapan.
javanese: Cundhuk karo uleman, kumpulane diwiwiti jam wolu.
english: In accordance with the invitation, the meeting starts at eight o'clock.

indonesian: Sesuai dengan undangan, rapatnya dimulai pukul delapan.
javanese: Cundhuk kaliyan uleman, kempalanipun dipunwiwiti pukul wolu.
english: In accordance with the invitation, the meeting starts at eight o'clock.

indonesian: Baju saya sudah jadi.
javanese: Klambiku wis dadi.
english: My clothes are ready.

indonesian: Baju saya sudah jadi.
javanese: Rasukan kula sampun dados
english: My clothes are ready.

indonesian: Bapak menjadi guru Sekolah Dasar.
javanese: Bapak dadi guru Sekolah Dasar.
english: Father became an elementary school teacher.

indonesian: Bapak menjadi guru Sekolah Dasar.
javanese: Bapak dados guru Sekolah Dasar.
english: Father became an elementary school teacher.

indonesian: Jadi ayahmu itu seorang guru?
javanese: Dadi bapakmu iku guru?
english: So your father is a teacher?

indonesian: Jadi ayahmu itu seorang guru?
javanese: Dados bapak sampeyan menika guru?
english: So your father is a teacher?

indonesian: Waktu ini saya sedang prihatin, semoga diberi iman yag kuat.
javanese: Wektu iku aku lagi dadi lakon, muga-muga diparingi iman sing kuwat.
english: At this time, I am concerned, hopefully I am given strong faith.

indonesian: Waktu ini saya sedang prihatin, semoga diberi iman yag kuat.
javanese: Wekdal menika kula saweg dados lampahan, mugi-mugi dipunparingi iman ingkang kiyat.
english: At this time, I am concerned, hopefully I am given strong faith.

indonesian: Dagangan ditawarkan kesana-kemari tidak laku, hanya menyebabkan mondar-mandir.
javanese: Tawa dagangan mrana-mrene ora payu, mung dadi laku.
english: The goods were offered here and there but didn't sell, only causing back-and-forth movement.

indonesian: Dagangan ditawarkan kesana-kemari tidak laku, hanya menyebabkan mondar-mandir.
javanese: Tawi dagangan mrika-mriki boten pajeng, namun dados lampah.
english: The goods were offered here and there but didn't sell, only causing back-and-forth movement.

indonesian: Menagih hutang tidak diberi, malah jadi pertengkaran.
javanese: Nagih utang ora diwenehi, malah dadi padu.
english: Demanding repayment of a debt was not met, and it instead led to an argument.

indonesian: Menagih hutang tidak diberi, malah jadi pertengkaran.
javanese: Nagih sambutan boten dipun-sukani, malah dados paben.
english: Demanding repayment of a debt was not met, and it instead led to an argument.

indonesian: Hanya melihat jatilan saja naik sepeda motor, setelah hilang dimarahi banyak orang.
javanese: Mung ndeleng jathilan wae nunggang pitmotor, bareng ilang dadi paran tutuhan.
english: Just watching the jatilan while riding a motorcycle, then got scolded by many people after disappearing.

indonesian: Hanya melihat jatilan saja naik sepeda motor, setelah hilang dimarahi banyak orang.
javanese: Namun nningali jathilan kemawon numpak pitmotor, sareng ical dados paran tetahan.
english: Just watching the jatilan while riding a motorcycle, then got scolded by many people after disappearing.

indonesian: Pulanglah saja supaya tidak selalu dipikirkan oleh saudara-saudaramu.
javanese: Muliha wae supaya ora dadi pikirane sadulur!
english: Just go home so that your siblings don't always worry about you.

indonesian: Pulanglah saja supaya tidak selalu dipikirkan oleh saudara-saudaramu.
javanese: Panjenengan kondur wae supaya ora dadi panggalihe para sadulur!
english: Just go home so that your siblings don't always worry about you.

indonesian: Pulanglah saja supaya tidak selalu dipikirkan oleh saudara-saudaramu.
javanese: Sampeyan manthuk kemawon supados boten dados manahipun para sadherek!
english: Just go home so that your siblings don't always worry about you.

indonesian: Pulanglah saja supaya tidak selalu dipikirkan oleh saudara-saudaramu.
javanese: Panjenengan kondur kemawon supados boten dado panggalihipun para sadherek!
english: Just go home so that your siblings don't always worry about you.

indonesian: Di desa, kamu bertempat tinggal bersama dengan saya!
javanese: Ana ing desa manggona dadi siji karo aku!
english: In the village, you live together with me!

indonesian: Di desa, kamu bertempat tinggal bersama dengan saya!
javanese: Wonten ing dhusun sampeyan manggen dados satunggal kaliyan kula!
english: In the village, you live together with me!

indonesian: Ikhlaskan saja uangnya, daripada berulang kali menagih hanya dimintai ditangguhkan, kan tidak lagi berkali-kali datang ke rumahnya!
javanese: Dhuwite eklasna wae, tinimbang bola bali nagih mung disemayani, tiwas dadi sikil!
english: Just let go of the money, rather than repeatedly asking for it and only being asked to postpone, right? You won't have to keep going to their house anymore!

indonesian: Ikhlaskan saja uangnya, daripada berulang kali menagih hanya dimintai ditangguhkan, kan tidak lagi berkali-kali datang ke rumahnya!
javanese: Artaniupun sampeyan eklasaken kemawon, tinimbang wongsal-wangsul nagih namung dipunsemadosi, tiwas dados suku!
english: Just let go of the money, rather than repeatedly asking for it and only being asked to postpone, right? You won't have to keep going to their house anymore!

indonesian: Ia sanggup prihatin, akhirnya sekarang dapat hidup bahagia.
javanese: Dheweke gelem prihatin, kadadeane saiki bisa urip mulya.
english: He was able to endure hardships, and now he can finally live happily.

indonesian: Ia sanggup prihatin, akhirnya sekarang dapat hidup bahagia.
javanese: Piyambakipun purun prihatos, kadadosanipun sameniko saged desang mulya.
english: He was able to endure hardships, and now he can finally live happily.

indonesian: Peristiwa kebakaran kemarin, sebabnya dari kompor meledak.
javanese: Kadadean kobongan dhek wingi, jalarane saka kompor jeblug.
english: Yesterday's fire incident was caused by an exploding stove.

indonesian: Peristiwa kebakaran kemarin, sebabnya dari kompor meledak.
javanese: Kadadosan kebesmen kala wingi, jalaranipun saking kompor njeblug.
english: Yesterday's fire incident was caused by an exploding stove.

indonesian: Setelah Dewata Cengkar terjun ke laut kemudian tidak sengaja berubah wujud menjadi buaya putih.
javanese: Sawise dewata cengkar nyemplung sagara banjur salah kadaden awujud bajul putih.
english: After Dewata Cengkar plunged into the sea, he accidentally transformed into a white crocodile.

indonesian: Setelah Dewata Cengkar terjun ke laut kemudian tidak sengaja berubah wujud menjadi buaya putih.
javanese: Sasampunipun dewata cengkar nyamplung saganten lajeng salah kedadosan awujud bajul putih.
english: After Dewata Cengkar plunged into the sea, he accidentally transformed into a white crocodile.

indonesian: Tawar-menawarnya mobil sudah berhasil (menjadi kesepakatan) dua puluh lima juta rupiah.
javanese: Enggone nyang-nyangan montor kedadeyan salawe yuta rupiah.
english: The negotiation for the car was successful (reaching an agreement) at twenty-five million rupiah.

indonesian: Tawar-menawarnya mobil sudah berhasil (menjadi kesepakatan) dua puluh lima juta rupiah.
javanese: Enggenipun awis-awisan montor kedadosan salangkung yuta rupiah.
english: The negotiation for the car was successful (reaching an agreement) at twenty-five million rupiah.

indonesian: Mangganya berbuah lebat itu kau beri pupuk apa?
javanese: Peleme bisa ndadi mengkono iku kok rabuk apa?
english: What kind of fertilizer did you use for the mango tree to bear so much fruit?

indonesian: Mangganya berbuah lebat itu kau beri pupuk apa?
javanese: Pelemipun sage ndados menika sampeyan rabuk menapa?
english: What kind of fertilizer did you use for the mango tree to bear so much fruit?

indonesian: Penari kuda lumping yang makan pecahan kaca itu sedang kemasukan roh.
javanese: Jathilan sing mangan beling kae lagi ndadi.
english: The kuda lumping dancer who ate glass shards is currently possessed by a spirit.

indonesian: Penari kuda lumping yang makan pecahan kaca itu sedang kemasukan roh.
javanese: Jathilan ingkang nedha beling menika saweg ndados.
english: The kuda lumping dancer who ate glass shards is currently possessed by a spirit.

indonesian: Sejak tadi menulis surat tidak kunjung jadi itu isinya apa?
javanese: Nulis layang wiwit mau ora dadi-dadi iku isine apa?
english: What have you been writing in the letter that still isn't finished?

indonesian: Sejak tadi menulis surat tidak kunjung jadi itu isinya apa?
javanese: Nyerat serat wiwit mau mbotten dado-dados menika isinipun menapa?
english: What have you been writing in the letter that still isn't finished?

indonesian: Kabel ini kau urai sepanjang mungkin.
javanese: Kabel iki uluren sadawa-dawane.
english: Untangle this cable as much as possible.

indonesian: Kabel ini kau urai sepanjang mungkin.
javanese: Kabel menika sampeyan ular sapanjang-panjangipun.
english: Untangle this cable as much as possible.

indonesian: Sepanjang-panjang hidup di dunia masih panjang di akhirat.
javanese: Sadawa-dawane urip ing donya isih dawa ing akerat.
english: The length of life in this world is still longer in the hereafter.

indonesian: Sepanjang-panjang hidup di dunia masih panjang di akhirat.
javanese: Sapanjang-panjangipun gesang ing donya taksih panjang ing akerat.
english: The length of life in this world is still longer in the hereafter.

indonesian: Para siswa harap semua menuntut ilmu yang utama.
javanese: Para siswa den samya marsudi kawruh utama.
english: The students are expected to prioritize acquiring knowledge.

indonesian: Para siswa harap semua menuntut ilmu yang utama.
javanese: Para siswa ingkang sami marsudi kawruh utami.
english: The students are expected to prioritize acquiring knowledge.

indonesian: Gambaranmu ini baiknya kalau dilihat dari kejauhan.
javanese: Gambaranmu iki apike yen dideleng saka kadohan.
english: Your picture is better viewed from a distance.

indonesian: Gambaranmu ini baiknya kalau dilihat dari kejauhan.
javanese: Gambaran panjenengan iki apike yen dipriksani saka kadohan.
english: Your picture is better viewed from a distance.

indonesian: Gambaranmu ini baiknya kalau dilihat dari kejauhan.
javanese: Gambaran sampeyan menika saenipun yen dipuntingali saking katebihan.
english: Your picture is better viewed from a distance.

indonesian: Gambaranmu ini baiknya kalau dilihat dari kejauhan.
javanese: Gambaran panjenengan menika saenipun yen dipunpriksani saking katebihan.
english: Your picture is better viewed from a distance.

indonesian: Jangan sakit hati saya lewat rumahmu tidak singgah karena bersama-sama banyak teman.
javanese: Aja dadi ati, aku liwat omahmu ora mampir, amarga bareng kanca akeh.
english: Don't be upset that I didn't stop by your house because I was with many friends.

indonesian: Jangan sakit hati saya lewat rumahmu tidak singgah karena bersama-sama banyak teman.
javanese: Aja dadi panggalih, adalem liwat dalem panjenengan ora mampir, amarga bareng kanca akeh.
english: Don't be upset that I didn't stop by your house because I was with many friends.

indonesian: Jangan sakit hati saya lewat rumahmu tidak singgah karena bersama-sama banyak teman.
javanese: Sampun dados manah, kula langkung griya sampeyan boten mampir, amargi sareng kanca kathah.
english: Don't be upset that I didn't stop by your house because I was with many friends.

indonesian: Jangan sakit hati saya lewat rumahmu tidak singgah karena bersama-sama banyak teman.
javanese: Sampun dados panggalih, adalem langkung dalem panjenengan boten mampir, amargi sareng kanca kathah.
english: Don't be upset that I didn't stop by your house because I was with many friends.

indonesian: Hanya terkejut membaca surat lalu menjadi penyebab kematian.
javanese: Mung kaget maca layang banjur dadi dalaning pati.
english: Just surprised to read the letter and then became the cause of death.

indonesian: Hanya terkejut membaca surat lalu menjadi penyebab kematian.
javanese: Namung kaget maos serat lajeng dados margining pejah.
english: Just surprised to read the letter and then became the cause of death.

indonesian: Jika kamu sakit, kamu merepotkan orang serumah.
javanese: Yen kowe lara, dadi gawene wong saomah.
english: If you are sick, you inconvenience everyone in the house.

indonesian: Jika kamu sakit, kamu merepotkan orang serumah.
javanese: Yen sampeyan sakit, dados damelipun tiyang sagriya.
english: If you are sick, you inconvenience everyone in the house.

indonesian: Mari makan, tetapi mengambil sendiri-sendiri, tidak perlu pelayanan!
javanese: Ayo padha mangan, nanging njupuk dhewe-dhewe, ora dadi laden!
english: Let's eat, but serve yourself, no need for service!

indonesian: Mari makan, tetapi mengambil sendiri-sendiri, tidak perlu pelayanan!
javanese: Mangga sami nedha, nanging mendhet piyambak-piyambak, boten dados ladosan!
english: Let's eat, but serve yourself, no need for service!

indonesian: Saya berjualan saja, biarpun hanya menjadi penjual cabai.
javanese: Dak dodolan wae, dadi-dadi bakul lombok.
english: I just sell, even if it's only as a chili seller.

english: The calculation was indeed for one hundred people, but one hundred twenty-one people showed up.

javanese: Bocah-bocah sing ora kepetung diwenehi wae, amarga konsumsine turah.

javanese: Lare-lare ingkang boten kepetang dipunsukani kemawon, amargi konsumsinipun tirah.
english: Countless children are just given, because their consumption is excessive.

indonesian: Ia itu wataknya hemat sekali, maka bisa kaya.
javanese: Dheweke iku watake petung, mula bisa sugih,

indonesian: Uang konsumsi seratus ribu rupiah untuk dua puluh lima orang, jadi perhitungannya tiap orang empat ribu rupiah.

indonesian: Jika memang membutuhkan uang, Anda saya beri uang, Anda berkata saja dan tidak perlu merasa repot sekali (dalam hati).

english: If you really need money, I will give you money. Just say it, and there's no need to feel very troubled (in your heart).

indonesian: Karena restumu keadaan saya serumah semua dianugerahi keselamatan.
javanese: Saka pangestumu kaananku saomah padha ginanjar slamet.
english: Because of your blessing, my entire household has been granted safety.

indonesian: Karena restumu keadaan saya serumah semua dianugerahi keselamatan.
javanese: Saka pangestu panjenengan kaanan adalem saomah padha ginanjar slamet.
english: Because of your blessing, my entire household has been granted safety.

indonesian: Karena restumu keadaan saya serumah semua dianugerahi keselamatan.
javanese: Saking pangestu sampeyan kawontenan kula sagriya sami ginanjar wilujeng.
english: Because of your blessing, my entire household has been granted safety.

indonesian: Karena restumu keadaan saya serumah semua dianugerahi keselamatan.
javanese: Saking pangestu panjenengan kawontenan adalem sagriya sami ginanjar wilujeng
english: Because of your blessing, my entire household has been granted safety.

indonesian: Semoga keadaan seanak istri/suami juga diberi keselamatan.
javanese: Muga-muga kaananmu saanak bojo uga diwenehi kaslametan.
english: May the condition of the spouse and children also be granted safety.

indonesian: Semoga keadaan seanak istri/suami juga diberi keselamatan.
javanese: Muga-muga kaanan panjenengan sagarwa putra uga diparingi kasugengan.
english: May the condition of the spouse and children also be granted safety.

indonesian: Semoga keadaan seanak istri/suami juga diberi keselamatan.
javanese: Mugi-mugi kawontenan sampeyan saanak semah ugi dipunsukani kawilujengan.
english: May the condition of the spouse and children also be granted safety.

indonesian: Semoga keadaan seanak istri/suami juga diberi keselamatan.
javanese: Mugi-mugi kawontenan panjenengan sagarwa putra ugi dipunparingi kasugengan.
english: May the condition of the spouse and children also be granted safety.

indonesian: Saya sedang pesta, kebetulan kamu datang.
javanese: Aku lagi mangan enak, kabeneran kowe teka.
english: I am at a party, and you happened to come.

indonesian: Saya sedang pesta, kebetulan kamu datang.
javanese: Kula saweg nedha eca, kaleresan sampeyan dhateng.
english: I am at a party, and you happened to come.

indonesian: Kamu kok memakai kacamata, apa sudah tidak begitu melihat?
javanese: Kowe kok nganggo kacamata, apa wis ora pati weruh?
english: Why are you wearing glasses? Are you having trouble seeing?

indonesian: Kamu kok memakai kacamata, apa sudah tidak begitu melihat?
javanese: Panjenengan kok ngagem kacatingal, apa wis ora pati priksa?
english: Why are you wearing glasses? Are you having trouble seeing?

indonesian: Kamu kok memakai kacamata, apa sudah tidak begitu melihat?
javanese: Sampeyan kok ngangge kacamripat, menapa sampun mboten patos sumerep?
english: Why are you wearing glasses? Are you having trouble seeing?

indonesian: Kamu kok memakai kacamata, apa sudah tidak begitu melihat?
javanese: Panjenengan kok ngagem kacatingal, menapa sampun mboten patos priksa?
english: Why are you wearing glasses? Are you having trouble seeing?

indonesian: Seandainya dibuat berbeda apa gunanya, dia itu kan bukan langganan!
javanese: Dikacekana apa gunane, dheweke iku rak dudu lengganan!
english: If it were made differently, what would be the point? He's not a regular customer!

indonesian: Seandainya dibuat berbeda apa gunanya, dia itu kan bukan langganan!
javanese: Dipunkaotana menapa ginanipun, piyambakipun menika rak sanes lengganan!
english: If it were made differently, what would be the point? He's not a regular customer!

indonesian: Berbeda sedikit tidak menjadi apa, sebab dia sudah lama menjadi langganan.
javanese: Kacek sathithik ora dadi apa, amarga dheweke wis suwe dadi langganan.
english: A little difference doesn't matter, because he has been a regular customer for a long time.

indonesian: Berbeda sedikit tidak menjadi apa, sebab dia sudah lama menjadi langganan.
javanese: Kaot sakedhik boten dados menapa, amargi piyambakipun sampun dangu dados langganan.
english: A little difference doesn't matter, because he has been a regular customer for a long time.

indonesian: Anakmu dahulu digebrak, maka tidak mudah terkejut.
javanese: Anakmu biyen digebrag, mula ora kagetan.
english: Your child was startled in the past, so they are not easily surprised now.

indonesian: Anakmu dahulu digebrak, maka tidak mudah terkejut.
javanese: Ingkang putra biyen digebrag, mula ora kejotan.
english: Your child was startled in the past, so they are not easily surprised now.

indonesian: Anakmu dahulu digebrak, maka tidak mudah terkejut.
javanese: Anak sampeyan rumiyin dipun-gebrag, mila boten kagetan.
english: Your child was startled in the past, so they are not easily surprised now.

indonesian: Anakmu dahulu digebrak, maka tidak mudah terkejut.
javanese: Ingkang putra rumiyin dipun-gebrag, mila boten kejotan.
english: Your child was startled in the past, so they are not easily surprised now.

indonesian: Anaknya diajak melihat jatilan, malah terkejut ketakutan melihat barongan.
javanese: Anake diajak ndeleng jathilan, malah kaget-kaget weruh barongan.
english: The child was invited to watch the jatilan performance, but instead was startled and frightened by the barongan.

indonesian: Anaknya diajak melihat jatilan, malah terkejut ketakutan melihat barongan.
javanese: Putranipun diajak mriksani jathilan, malah kejot-kejot priksa barongan.
english: The child was invited to watch the jatilan performance, but instead was startled and frightened by the barongan.

indonesian: Anaknya diajak melihat jatilan, malah terkejut ketakutan melihat barongan.
javanese: Anakipun dipunajak ningali jathilan, malah kaget-kaget sumerep barongan.
english: The child was invited to watch the jatilan performance, but instead was startled and frightened by the barongan.

indonesian: Anaknya diajak melihat jatilan, malah terkejut ketakutan melihat barongan.
javanese: Putranipun dipunajak mriksani jathilan, malah kejot-kejot priksa barongan.
english: The child was invited to watch the jatilan performance, but instead was startled and frightened by the barongan.

indonesian: Biarpun kamu dalam sepakbola selalu kalah saja, hatimu jangan putus asa!
javanese: Sanajan enggonmu bal-balan kalah-kalah wae, atimu aja nglokro!
english: Even though you always lose in soccer, don't let your heart lose hope!

indonesian: Biarpun kamu dalam sepakbola selalu kalah saja, hatimu jangan putus asa!
javanese: Sanajan enggen sampeyan bal-balan kawon-kawon kemawon, manah sampeyan sampun nglokro!
english: Even though you always lose in soccer, don't let your heart lose hope!

indonesian: Membelinya sepatu ini tadi ada kemurahan dua puluh lima persen.
javanese: Enggone tuku sepatu iki mau ana kamurahan salawe persen.
english: I bought these shoes earlier with a twenty-five percent discount.

indonesian: Membelinya sepatu ini tadi ada kemurahan dua puluh lima persen.
javanese: Enggenipun tumbas sepatu menika wau wonten kamirahan selangkung persen.
english: I bought these shoes earlier with a twenty-five percent discount.

indonesian: Saya dapat membuat rumah ini hanya karena dari kemurahan Tuhan Yang Maha Kasih.
javanese: Aku bisa gawe omah iki mung marga saka kamurahan Dalem Gusti Kang Maha Asih.
english: I was able to build this house only because of the grace of the Most Merciful God.

indonesian: Saya dapat membuat rumah ini hanya karena dari kemurahan Tuhan Yang Maha Kasih.
javanese: Kula saged damel griya menika namung saking kamirahan Dalem Gusti Ingkang Maha Asih.
english: I was able to build this house only because of the grace of the Most Merciful God.

indonesian: Orang hidup itu di sana-sini sama saja, yang penting dapat tenteram.
javanese: Wong urip iku ing kana-kene padha wae, sing wigati bisa tentrem.
english: People are the same everywhere, what matters is finding peace.

indonesian: Orang hidup itu di sana-sini sama saja, yang penting dapat tenteram.
javanese: Tiyang gesang menika ing ngrika-ngriki sami kemawon, ingkang wigatos saged tentrem.
english: People are the same everywhere, what matters is finding peace.

indonesian: Naik taksi ke Semarang tidak sampai tiga jam.
javanese: Nunggang taksi tekan Semarang ora kanti telung jam.
english: Taking a taxi to Semarang takes less than three hours.

indonesian: Naik taksi ke Semarang tidak sampai tiga jam.
javanese: Numpak taksi dumugi Semarang boten kantos tigang jam.
english: Taking a taxi to Semarang takes less than three hours.

indonesian: Jika naik bis tidak sabar, baiknya taksi saja.
javanese: Yen nunggang bis ora kanti, becike taksi wae.
english: If taking the bus is too slow, it's better to take a taxi.

indonesian: Jika naik bis tidak sabar, baiknya taksi saja.
javanese: Yen numpak bis boten kantos, saenipun taksi kemawon.
english: If taking the bus is too slow, it's better to take a taxi.

indonesian: Jika kamu sudah mempunyai istri/suami, hendaklah dapat momong mertua.
javanese: Yen kowe wis duwe bojo, kang bisa momong maratuwa.
english: If you already have a wife/husband, you should be able to take care of your in-laws.

indonesian: Jika kamu sudah mempunyai istri/suami, hendaklah dapat momong mertua.
javanese: Yen panjenengan wis kagungan garwa, kang bisa momong maratuwa.
english: If you already have a wife/husband, you should be able to take care of your in-laws.

indonesian: Jika kamu sudah mempunyai istri/suami, hendaklah dapat momong mertua.
javanese: Yen sampeyan sampun gadhah semah, ingkang saged momong marasepuh.
english: If you already have a wife/husband, you should be able to take care of your in-laws.

indonesian: Jika kamu sudah mempunyai istri/suami, hendaklah dapat momong mertua.
javanese: Yen panjenengan sampun kagungan garwa, ingkang saged momong marasepuh.
english: If you already have a wife/husband, you should be able to take care of your in-laws.

indonesian: Kautunjukkan wayang kepada saya, Raden Gathutkaca itu yang mana?
javanese: Aku tuduhana wayang, Raden Gathutkaca iku kang endi?
english: You showed me the puppet, which one is Raden Gathutkaca?

indonesian: Kautunjukkan wayang kepada saya, Raden Gathutkaca itu yang mana?
javanese: Kula sampeyan tedahaken ringgit, Raden Gathutkaca menika ingkang pundi?
english: You showed me the puppet, which one is Raden Gathutkaca?

indonesian: Itu adikmu menangis, oleh ibunya diapakan?
javanese: Kae adhimu nangis, dening ibune dikapakake?
english: That's your younger sibling crying, what did their mother do to them?

indonesian: Itu adikmu menangis, oleh ibunya diapakan?
javanese: Menika rayi sampeyan nangis, dening ibunipun dipunmenapakaken?
english: That's your younger sibling crying, what did their mother do to them?

indonesian: Adik saya tidak diapa-apakan, hanya baru dimandikan.
javanese: Adhiku ora dikapak-kapakake, mung lagi didusi.
english: My younger sibling wasn't harmed, just recently bathed.

indonesian: Adik saya tidak diapa-apakan, hanya baru dimandikan.
javanese: Adhi kula boten dipunmenapak-menapakaken, namung saweg dipundusi.
english: My younger sibling wasn't harmed, just recently bathed.

indonesian: Aku terkabari oleh teman-teman, katanya kamu menjadi direktur?
javanese: Aku keprungon saka kanca-kanca, jare kowe dadi dhirektur?
english: I was informed by friends that you became a director?

indonesian: Aku terkabari oleh teman-teman, katanya kamu menjadi direktur?
javanese: Kula kapirengan saking kanca-kanca, criyosipun sampeyan dados dhirektur?
english: I was informed by friends that you became a director?

indonesian: Saya tidak dapat berjalan cepat, lama-kelamaan jadi tertinggal.
javanese: Aku ora bisa mlaku banter, suwe-suwe dadi kari.
english: I can't walk fast, so I gradually fall behind.

indonesian: Saya tidak dapat berjalan cepat, lama-kelamaan jadi tertinggal.
javanese: Kula boten saged mlampah banter, dangu-dangu dados kantun.
english: I can't walk fast, so I gradually fall behind.

indonesian: Bangunlah pagi-pagi, supaya tidak terlambat sekolahnya!
javanese: Tangia esuk, supaya ora kari enggone sekolah!
english: Wake up early, so you won't be late for school!

indonesian: Bangunlah pagi-pagi, supaya tidak terlambat sekolahnya!
javanese: Sampeyan tangi enjing, supados boten kantun anggenipun sekolah!
english: Wake up early, so you won't be late for school!

indonesian: Saya membeli jeruk lima, sekarang masih satu.
javanese: Aku tuku jeruk lima, saiki kari siji.
english: I bought five oranges, now there's only one left.

indonesian: Saya membeli jeruk lima, sekarang masih satu.
javanese: Kula tumbas jeram gangsal, samenika kantun satunggal.
english: I bought five oranges, now there's only one left.

indonesian: Sudah persiapan sejak pagi, ternyata tamunya tidak datang.
javanese: Wis cecawis sekesuk, kari-kari dhayohe ora teka.
english: Prepared since the morning, it turns out the guest did not come.

indonesian: Sudah persiapan sejak pagi, ternyata tamunya tidak datang.
javanese: Sampun cecawis sakenjing, kantun-kantun tamunipun boten dhateng.
english: Prepared since the morning, it turns out the guest did not come.

indonesian: Dua dan tiga ada lima.
javanese: Loro karo telu ana lima.
english: Two and three make five.

indonesian: Dua dan tiga ada lima.
javanese: Kalih kaliyan tiga wonten gangsal.
english: Two and three make five.

indonesian: Anaknya baru melamar pekerjaan, belum tentu diterima.
javanese: Bocahe lagi nglamar pagaweyan, durung karuwan katampa.
english: Her child just applied for a job, but it's not certain that they will be accepted.

indonesian: Anaknya baru melamar pekerjaan, belum tentu diterima.
javanese: Larenipun saweg nglamar padamelan dereng kantenan katampi.
english: Her child just applied for a job, but it's not certain that they will be accepted.

indonesian: Yang melamar pekerjaan luar biasa banyaknya.
javanese: Sing nglamar pagawean akehe ora karuwan.
english: The number of job applicants is extraordinarily high.

indonesian: Yang melamar pekerjaan luar biasa banyaknya.
javanese: Ingkang nglamar padamelan kathahipun boten kantenan.
english: The number of job applicants is extraordinarily high.

indonesian: Naik kapal terbang itu rasanya seperti apa?
javanese: Nunggang montor mabur iku rasane kaya apa?
english: What does it feel like to fly on an airplane?

indonesian: Naik kapal terbang itu rasanya seperti apa?
javanese: Numpak montor mabur menika raosipun kados menapa?
english: What does it feel like to fly on an airplane?

indonesian: Pertanyaannya bagaimana? Sukar atau mudah?
javanese: Pitakone kaya ngapa? Angel apa gampang?
english: The question, how is it? Difficult or easy?

indonesian: Pertanyaannya bagaimana? Sukar atau mudah?
javanese: Pitakenipun kados pundi? Angel menapa gampil?
english: The question, how is it? Difficult or easy?

indonesian: Bemo itu mirip dengan becak, hanya saja memakai mesin.
javanese: Bemo iku kaya dene becak, mung wae mawa mesin.
english: The bemo is similar to a becak, except it uses an engine.

indonesian: Bemo itu mirip dengan becak, hanya saja memakai mesin.
javanese: Bemo menika kados dene becak, namung kemawon mawi mesin.
english: The bemo is similar to a becak, except it uses an engine.

indonesian: Contohnya seperti itu, kok gambaranmu hanya seperti ini.
javanese: Contone kaya mangkana, kok gambaranmu mung kaya mangkene.
english: For example, it's like that, but why is your depiction only like this?

indonesian: Contohnya seperti itu, kok gambaranmu hanya seperti ini.
javanese: Contonipun kados makaten, kok gambaran sampeyan namung kados makaten.
english: For example, it's like that, but why is your depiction only like this?

indonesian: Fotonya seperti ini, ternyata anaknya hanya seperti itu.
javanese: Potrete kaya mangkene, jebul bocahe mung kaya mangkono.
english: The photo looks like this, but it turns out the child is only like that.

indonesian: Fotonya seperti ini, ternyata anaknya hanya seperti itu.
javanese: Potretipun kados makaten, jebul larenipun namung kados makaten.
english: The photo looks like this, but it turns out the child is only like that.

indonesian: Waktu sekolah sepertinya engkau satu kelas dengan saya?
javanese: Nalika sekolah kaya-kaya kowe sa-klas karo aku?
english: Were you in the same class as me during school?

indonesian: Waktu sekolah sepertinya engkau satu kelas dengan saya?
javanese: Nalika sekolah kados-kados sampeyan sa-klas kaliyan kula?
english: Were you in the same class as me during school?

indonesian: Jika menyetel TV, tombolnya dibeginikan (dengan menekan tombol).
javanese: Yen nyetel TV, pejetane dikenekake!
english: If you want to set the TV, you do it like this (by pressing the button).

indonesian: Jika menyetel TV, tombolnya dibeginikan (dengan menekan tombol).
javanese: Yen nyetel TV, pejetanipun dipunkatenaken (dipunmakatenaken)!
english: If you want to set the TV, you do it like this (by pressing the button).

indonesian: Biarpun hingga disambung dengan obor (sudah malam) berangkatlah hari ini!
javanese: Ora ketung sambung obor, mangkata dina iki!
english: Even though it is already night (lit by torches), set off today!

indonesian: Biarpun hingga disambung dengan obor (sudah malam) berangkatlah hari ini!
javanese: Boten ketang sambet obor, sampeyan mangkat dinten menika!
english: Even though it is already night (lit by torches), set off today!

indonesian: Anak nakal itu perlu dinasehati, jangan sampai menjadi-jadi.
javanese: Bocah nakal iku perlu dikandhani, aja nganti kebanjur-banjur.
english: The naughty child needs to be advised, so it doesn't get worse.

indonesian: Anak nakal itu perlu dinasehati, jangan sampai menjadi-jadi.
javanese: Lare nakal menika perlu dipun criyosi, sampun ngantos kelajeng-lajeng.
english: The naughty child needs to be advised, so it doesn't get worse.

indonesian: Matamu kok kejap berkali-kali itu kenapa?
javanese: Matamu kok kedhep nrithil iku kena apa?
english: Why are your eyes blinking repeatedly like that?

indonesian: Matamu kok kejap berkali-kali itu kenapa?
javanese: Tinggal panjenengan kok kejep nrithil iku kena apa?
english: Why are your eyes blinking repeatedly like that?

indonesian: Matamu kok kejap berkali-kali itu kenapa?
javanese: Mripat sampeyan kok kedhep nrithil menika kenging menapa?
english: Why are your eyes blinking repeatedly like that?

indonesian: Matamu kok kejap berkali-kali itu kenapa?
javanese: Tingal panjenengan kok kejep nrithil menika kenging menapa?
english: Why are your eyes blinking repeatedly like that?

indonesian: Ambilkan kelud untuk membersihkan tempat tidur!
javanese: Jupukna kelud kanggo ngresiki peturon!
english: Get the duster to clean the bed!

indonesian: Ambilkan kelud untuk membersihkan tempat tidur!
javanese: Panjenengan pundhutake samparan kanggo ngrisiki pasarean!
english: Get the duster to clean the bed!

indonesian: Ambilkan kelud untuk membersihkan tempat tidur!
javanese: Sampeyan pendhetaken kelud kangge ngresiki patileman!
english: Get the duster to clean the bed!

indonesian: Ambilkan kelud untuk membersihkan tempat tidur!
javanese: Panjenengan pundhutaken samparan kagem ngresiki pasarean!
english: Get the duster to clean the bed!

indonesian: Istrinya hamil, tetapi baru tiga bulan lalu keguguran.
javanese: Bojone meteng, nanging lagi telung sasi banjur keluron.
english: His wife is pregnant, but she had a miscarriage just three months ago.

indonesian: Istrinya hamil, tetapi baru tiga bulan lalu keguguran.
javanese: Garwane mbobot, nanging lagi telung sasi banjur terag.
english: His wife is pregnant, but she had a miscarriage just three months ago.

indonesian: Istrinya hamil, tetapi baru tiga bulan lalu keguguran.
javanese: Semahipun wawrat, nanging saweg tigang wulan lajeng keluron.
english: His wife is pregnant, but she had a miscarriage just three months ago.

indonesian: Istrinya hamil, tetapi baru tiga bulan lalu keguguran.
javanese: Garwanipun mbobot, nanging saweg tigang wulan lajeng terag.
english: His wife is pregnant, but she had a miscarriage just three months ago.

indonesian: Jika tidur memakailah selimut itu!
javanese: Yen turu nganggoa kemul kuwi!
english: If you sleep, use that blanket!

indonesian: Jika tidur memakailah selimut itu!
javanese: Yen sare panjenengan ngagem singeb kuwi!
english: If you sleep, use that blanket!

indonesian: Jika tidur memakailah selimut itu!
javanese: Yen tilem sampeyan ngangge kemul menika!
english: If you sleep, use that blanket!

indonesian: Jika tidur memakailah selimut itu!
javanese: Yen sare panjenengan ngagem singeb menika!
english: If you sleep, use that blanket!

indonesian: Ayamnya dilempar kena punggungnya.
javanese: Pitike dibalang kena gegere.
english: The chicken was thrown and hit his/her back.

indonesian: Ayamnya dilempar kena punggungnya.
javanese: Ayamipun dipunbalang kenging gegeripun.
english: The chicken was thrown and hit his/her back.

indonesian: Airnya dapat untuk mandi.
javanese: Banyune kena kanggo adus.
english: The water can be used for bathing.

indonesian: Airnya dapat untuk mandi.
javanese: Toyanipun kenging kangge adus.
english: The water can be used for bathing.

indonesian: Ia terlalu merasa enak, ikut piknik tidak membayar.
javanese: Dheweke kekepenaken, melu plesir ora mbayar.
english: He feels too comfortable, joining the picnic without paying.

indonesian: Ia terlalu merasa enak, ikut piknik tidak membayar.
javanese: Piyambakipun kesekecanen, tumut plesir boten mbayar.
english: He feels too comfortable, joining the picnic without paying.

indonesian: Cuci mukalah sebentar, supaya tidak mengentarai jika barusaja habis menangis!
javanese: Raupa sadhela, mundhak ngetarani yen mentas nangis!
english: Wash your face for a moment, so it's not obvious that you've just been crying!

indonesian: Cuci mukalah sebentar, supaya tidak mengentarai jika barusaja habis menangis!
javanese: Sampeyan raup sekedhap, mindhak ngetawisi yen mentas nangis!
english: Wash your face for a moment, so it's not obvious that you've just been crying!

indonesian: Kakak perempuan saya ke kantor pos akan mengirim surat.
javanese: Mbakyuku menyang kantor pos arep ngirim layang.
